name: lent_et_langoureux
description: Original slow 3/4 piece: Satie-like bass-then-chord swaying on soft keys, Debussy colours (parallel ninth chords, lydian #11, a Db9#11 whole-tone dominant), a sparse high melody leaning on colour tones, all floating on a breathing supersaw pad, slow detuned sub swells, tape air and a long dark plate reverb.
